status: research-only proposal; no maintainer agreement or production adoption
contract: Optional context cache ownership; default process behavior unchanged; context resolution never mutates ambient; identified scopes exclude legacy and bundled file sources.
scope_change: Graph winners use a scoped v2 managed-store peer while eager/default retains v1 JSON. This relaxes the earlier proposed requirement to persist graph-policy winners in v1 JSON; no SGLang production change is authorized by this prototype.
limits: Concurrent tuning/serving remains unqualified because existing tuning counters are process-global.
No CUDA capture, native numerical or performance validation.
Current main is unreleased and does not include the separately qualified descriptor overlay.
Identified context tuning rejects rank_tactics(k>1); k1/replay/skip remain supported.
Reload inside context scope is unsupported; outside it remains ambient-only.
Scope isolates lookup/attachment and guarded candidate invalidation, not arbitrary global v1 load/save calls.
Real distributed coordination, native CUDA capture and concurrent tuning/serving remain unqualified.
